description: A transfer requested by a registered agent is recorded as delegated, with its depth.
note: This is the field R.16 does not have. Its required set -- name, account number or unique transaction reference, address or national identity number or customer identification number or date and place of birth, plus LEI or BIC for a legal person -- identifies whose money moved and never who instructed the movement. A transfer record of an agent-initiated payment therefore names a person who pressed nothing, and nothing in the format separates them from a person who reviewed and sent it or one whose credentials were stolen. An AEGL holds that fact and this is where it goes.
